Smt. Annapurna Alias Durgesh Kumari vs State Of U.P. on 15
July, 2024

Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:112468
Court No. - 67
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 24791 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt. Annapurna Alias Durgesh Kumari
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mayank Krishna S Chandel,Vinod Kumar Chandel

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No.29 of 2024, registered under Sections 304-B, 498A, 201 & 316 I.P.C. &
Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Aurangabad, District Bulandshahar during pendency of the trial.
3. Allegation in the FIR is that informant's daughter marriage was solemnized with son of the applicant.
Thereafter applicant and other co-accused were demanding dowry.

When demand of Smt. Annapurna Alias Durgesh Kumari vs State Of U.P. on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112228597/
1 dowry was not fulfilled they started torturing the deceased, as a result, the deceased committed suicide.

entities.text: Smt. Annapurna Alias Durgesh Kumari vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Deceased has one and a half year baby.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased.
On perusal of the statement of the witnesses, it is apparent that the applicant has not made any demand of dowry.
It is a case of suicide.
Prima-facie there is no evidence against the applicant to implicate her in the present case.
Informant was informed regarding death of the deceased and cremation was done in the presence of first informant and his family members.
Applicant has no criminal history.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 16.03.2024.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Smt.Annapurna @ Durgesh Kumari, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 15.7.2024 SKD  Smt. Annapurna Alias Durgesh Kumari vs State Of U.P. on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112228597/
